title: Funding evidence capture and market-data binding
changes: Added immutable funding-evidence artifact schema with provenance status.
Bound every funding artifact to the exact SHA-256 bytes of the market-data artifact used by OOS/replay.
Added deterministic funding-evidence fingerprint verification on reload.
Added strict replay validation for schema, ordering, market-data hash, and funding fingerprint.
Prevented FIXTURE/UNKNOWN funding artifacts from being promoted to executable FundingSchedule instances.
Added a venue-evidence source identity to executable funding events.
notes: The machinery is ready to capture genuine Delta funding, but no live/provider response is represented as REAL in this checkpoint. No synthetic funding artifact is used as production evidence.
